Count paired-end fragments from these BAM files, infer strandedness, quantify transcripts and normalize across samples.

These inclusion/exclusion counts and sample groups are already prepared. Calculate per-sample PSI at the declared coverage floor and treated-minus-control mean PSI delta; preserve low coverage as not estimable and do no significance testing.
Discover novel splice junctions from BAM, reconstruct isoforms and run genome-wide differential splicing significance tests.

For this exact feature-by-sample nonnegative amplicon count table, report observed features, natural-log Shannon and Simpson per sample, keeping zero depth not estimable. Do not rarefy or compare groups.
Rarefy the table, compute beta diversity, test differential abundance and identify pathogens.

Fit an adjusted Cox model with competing risks and time-varying covariates, then produce patient-level clinical risk predictions.
